reasons: Direction is correct: HDI is the service provider under §1.1 (designs, develops, hosts the Site) and the Company is our client, so the inserted indemnity runs from HDI to the Company and its affiliates.

'Missing' status is supported by the record: §9 contains only mutual corporate-authority reps plus the Globix carve-out, and no defence/hold-harmless language appears anywhere; absence of any Vendor IP indemnity is walk-away territory under INDEMN.

Inserted language reaches the preferred position — third-party IP infringement, breach of law, unauthorised access to Content/Confidential Information, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct — plus standard notice/control/cooperation procedure with a material-prejudice qualifier and a consent gate on settlements.

The reciprocal Company indemnity is deliberately narrow (Company-supplied Content/Marks and Company's breach of law), matching the playbook's preferred framing rather than expanding our client's exposure.

Placement as §9(c)–(e) with the minimal heading change ('Warranties; Indemnification') is the smallest workable edit and, as the rationale notes, brings the clause within the §10.7 survival list; the 0.548 changed-character ratio on p0055 reflects only the short heading, not a rewrite.

Comment is accurate, concise, cites the playbook position and offers the sensible fallback (usual IP exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies); the absent super-cap is a non-material sub-element appropriately left to negotiation.
